# kubernetes — 2019 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 29 kubernetes CVEs of 2019 are in `data/cve/vendors/kubernetes/2019.jsonl`.

### CVE-2019-11253 — Kubernetes API Server JSON/YAML parsing vulnerable to resource exhaustion attack
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2019-10-17 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`

Improper input validation in the Kubernetes API server in versions v1.0-1.12 and versions prior to v1.13.12, v1.14.8, v1.15.5, and v1.16.2 allows authorized users to send malicious YAML or JSON payloads, causing the API server to consume excessive CPU or memory, potentially crashing and becoming unavailable. Prior to v1.14.0, default RBAC policy authorized anonymous users to submit requests that could trigger this vulnerability. Clusters upgraded from a version prior to v1.14.0 keep the more permissive policy by default for backwards compatibility.

**workarounds:** Exposure to requests from unauthenticated users can be mitigated by removing all write permissions from unauthenticated users, following instructions at https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/83253

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes: affected prior to 1.13.12; affected prior to 1.14.8; affected prior to 1.15.5; affected prior to 1.16.2; affected 1.1; affected 1.2; affected 1.3; affected 1.4; affected 1.5; affected 1.6; affected 1.7; affected 1.8; affected 1.9; affected 1.10; affected 1.11 …(+1 more in JSONL)
